Armour: light armour, medium armour and shields (not used in battles yet).
Weapons: simple weapons and martial weapons (not used in battles yet).

acolyte.name: Acolyte
facts: Ability boosts: WIS +2 and CHA +1.
Skills: Insight and Religion.
Keepsake: prayer beads (not used in battles yet).
acolyte.hook: You were raised in the Church of the Hearth. You have recited the Gift of the Flame a thousand times. Mother Aubrine wrote to you herself, asking you to come home to Emberwick.

criminal.name: Criminal
facts: Ability boosts: DEX +2 and CON +1.
Skills: Sleight of Hand and Stealth.
Keepsake: crowbar (not used in battles yet).
criminal.hook: You ran with the river smugglers once. Rook remembers you, and remembers that you still owe the Ash Market for a job that went wrong.

entertainer.name: Entertainer
facts: Ability boosts: DEX +1 and CHA +2.
Skills: Acrobatics and Performance.
Keepsake: wooden flute (not used in battles yet).
entertainer.hook: You learned your trade from Lark, the last songkeeper, who taught you the Warden songs and then vanished.

folk_hero.name: Folk Hero
facts: Ability boosts: STR +2 and WIS +1.
Skills: Animal Handling and Survival.
Keepsake: battered shovel (not used in battles yet).
folk_hero.hook: You stood up for Emberwick once, and the town still tells the story. Now the town is going hungry, and they're looking at you again.

guild_artisan.name: Guild Artisan
facts: Ability boosts: DEX +1 and INT +2.
Skills: Insight and Persuasion.
Keepsake: artisan's tools (not used in battles yet).
guild_artisan.hook: Tobin Fell taught you your craft at his ember-forge. His forge is going cold, and so is yours.

hermit.name: Hermit
facts: Ability boosts: CON +1 and WIS +2.
Skills: Medicine and Religion.
Keepsake: herbalism kit (not used in battles yet).
hermit.hook: You lived alone for years on the burned bank near Old Maud, and never once used ember-fire. Your memory is the sharpest in the Vale.

noble.name: Noble
facts: Ability boosts: INT +1 and CHA +2.
Skills: History and Persuasion.
Keepsake: signet ring (not used in battles yet).
noble.hook: Your family is minor gentry that owes everything to the Marrowbys. Lady Celandine has asked you, personally, to make sure the adventurers don't upset the town's arrangements.

outlander.name: Outlander
facts: Ability boosts: STR +1 and CON +2.
Skills: Athletics and Survival.
Keepsake: hunting trap (not used in battles yet).
outlander.hook: You weren't born in the Vale. You came over the Greywall as a child with no memory of the crossing, and you have always dreamed of a fire.

sage.name: Sage
facts: Ability boosts: CON +1 and INT +2.
Skills: Arcana and History.
Keepsake: bottle of ink (not used in battles yet).
sage.hook: You came to Emberwick to study the ember under the ford. You've noticed gaps in your own notes, in your own handwriting, about things you don't remember.

sailor.name: Sailor
facts: Ability boosts: STR +2 and DEX +1.
Skills: Athletics and Perception.
Keepsake: belaying pin (not used in battles yet).
sailor.hook: You worked the river boats from Emberwick's docks. You've seen what moves at night under the Ash Market's lanterns.

soldier.name: Soldier
facts: Ability boosts: STR +2 and CON +1.
Skills: Athletics and Intimidation.
Keepsake: bone dice (not used in battles yet).
soldier.hook: You served in the ford garrison under Dagna Holt. You were on the bridge the day the goblins took it, and you lived.

urchin.name: Urchin
facts: Ability boosts: DEX +2 and WIS +1.
Skills: Sleight of Hand and Stealth.
Keepsake: city map (not used in battles yet).
urchin.hook: You grew up on Emberwick's streets with Pip, and you look out for her. Lately she's been remembering things that frighten you both.

barbarian.cleaving_blow.name: Cleaving Blow
barbarian.cleaving_blow.text: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage; pushes target 1 tile away

barbarian.rage.name: Rage
barbarian.rage.text: Self: you are Raging for 3 rounds; if the round is at least 1, target gains 1d6 + CON modifier temporary HP — You enter a primal rage for 3 rounds: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, +2 weapon damage (+3 from level 9) and advantage on STR saves.

barbarian.reckless_attack.name: Reckless Attack
barbarian.reckless_attack.text: Self: you are Reckless for 1 round — You throw aside all defence: advantage on your attacks this round, but attacks against you also have advantage.

bard.bardic_inspiration.name: Bardic Inspiration
bard.bardic_inspiration.text: 6 tiles: target gains 1d6 + CHA modifier temporary HP; target is Inspired for 1 round

bard.dissonant_whispers.name: Dissonant Whispers
bard.dissonant_whispers.text: Wis save, 6 tiles: 3d6 psychic; pushes target 2 tiles away; half damage on a save

bard.faerie_fire.name: Faerie Fire
bard.faerie_fire.text: 6 tiles, burst 2: reveals hidden enemies (burst 2); Dex save (target is Lit for 3 rounds)

bard.heroism.name: Heroism
bard.heroism.text: 1 tile: target gains 1d6 + casting modifier temporary HP; ends fear conditions on target

bard.minor_illusion.name: Minor Illusion
bard.minor_illusion.text: Int save, 5 tiles: target gets -2 to attack rolls for 1 round

bard.thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
bard.thunderwave.text: Con save, self, burst 1: 2d8 thunder; pushes target 1 tile away; half damage on a save

bard.vicious_mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
bard.vicious_mockery.text: Wis save, 6 tiles: 1d4 psychic; target has disadvantage on its attack rolls for 1 round

cleric.bane.name: Bane
cleric.bane.text: Cha save, 4 tiles, burst 1: target gets -2 to attack rolls and -2 Str saves and -2 Dex saves and -2 Con saves and -2 Int saves and -2 Wis saves and -2 Cha saves for 10 rounds

cleric.bless.name: Bless
cleric.bless.text: 4 tiles, burst 1: target gets +2 to attack rolls and +2 Str saves and +2 Dex saves and +2 Con saves and +2 Int saves and +2 Wis saves and +2 Cha saves for 10 rounds

cleric.command.name: Command
cleric.command.text: Wis save, 6 tiles: target is Incapacitated for 1 round — "Halt!" The target stands still and does nothing on its next turn.

cleric.guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
cleric.guiding_bolt.text: Spell attack, 6 tiles: 4d6 radiant; target is Lit for 1 round

cleric.inflict_wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
cleric.inflict_wounds.text: Con save, 1 tile: 2d10 necrotic; half damage on a save

cleric.resistance.name: Resistance
cleric.resistance.text: 1 tile: target gets +1 Str saves and +1 Dex saves and +1 Con saves and +1 Int saves and +1 Wis saves and +1 Cha saves for 10 rounds

cleric.shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
cleric.shield_of_faith.text: 6 tiles: target gets +2 AC for 10 rounds

cleric.toll_the_dead.name: Toll the Dead
cleric.toll_the_dead.text: Wis save, 6 tiles: if the target is below 100% HP, 1d12 necrotic; otherwise 1d8 necrotic

cleric.turn_undead.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
cleric.turn_undead.text: Self, burst 3: if the target is undead, Wis save (target is Frightened until saved)

dragonborn.breath_weapon.name: Breath Weapon
dragonborn.breath_weapon.text: Dex save, self, cone 3: 1d10 fire; half damage on a save

druid.entangle.name: Entangle
druid.entangle.text: 6 tiles, burst 1: creates a entangle zone (burst 1) for 10 rounds, difficult terrain, ends if you lose concentration; Str save (target is Restrained until saved)

druid.faerie_fire.name: Faerie Fire
druid.faerie_fire.text: 6 tiles, burst 2: reveals hidden enemies (burst 2); Dex save (target is Lit for 3 rounds)

druid.fog_cloud.name: Fog Cloud
druid.fog_cloud.text: 6 tiles, burst 2: creates a smoke zone (burst 2) for 3 rounds, blocks line of sight, ends if you lose concentration

druid.shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
druid.shillelagh.text: Self: you get +2 to attack rolls and +2 weapon damage for 3 rounds

druid.thorn_whip.name: Thorn Whip
druid.thorn_whip.text: Spell attack, 4 tiles: 1d6 piercing; pulls target up to 2 tiles toward you

druid.thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
druid.thunderwave.text: Con save, self, burst 1: 2d8 thunder; pushes target 1 tile away; half damage on a save

druid.wild_shape_wolf.name: Wild Shape: Wolf
druid.wild_shape_wolf.text: Self: transforms into a form wolf

dwarf.stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
dwarf.stoneskin.text: Self: you resist bludgeoning, piercing, slashing for 1 round — Your skin takes on the hardness of the mountain's bones.

elf.fey_step.name: Fey Step
elf.fey_step.text: 4 tiles: teleports you to the aimed tile, up to 4 tiles away

fighter.action_surge.name: Action Surge
fighter.action_surge.text: Self: you gain an extra action this turn

fighter.feinting_attack.name: Feint
fighter.feinting_attack.text: Self: you get +4 weapon damage and have advantage on your attack rolls until the end of your turn — A feint opens your foe up: advantage and +4 damage on your attacks this turn.

fighter.goading_attack.name: Goading Attack
fighter.goading_attack.text: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage + 1d8; Wis save (taunts target for 1 round). With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits

fighter.menacing_attack.name: Menacing Attack
fighter.menacing_attack.text: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage + 1d8; Wis save (target is Frightened for 1 round). With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits

fighter.precision_attack.name: Precision Attack
fighter.precision_attack.text: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage. With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits — Your superiority die steadies the blow: +4 to hit.

fighter.pushing_attack.name: Pushing Attack
fighter.pushing_attack.text: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage + 1d8; Str save (pushes target 2 tiles away). With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits

fighter.rally.name: Rally
fighter.rally.text: 6 tiles: target gains 1d8 + CHA modifier temporary HP

fighter.second_wind.name: Second Wind
fighter.second_wind.text: Self: heals 1d4 + level — Game balance: one use per battle, restoring 1d4 plus your level HP.

fighter.trip_attack.name: Trip Attack
fighter.trip_attack.text: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage + 1d8; Str save (target is Prone). With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits

gnome.cunning.name: Cunning
gnome.cunning.text: Advantage on Int and Wis and Cha saves

goliath.stones_endurance.name: Stone's Endurance
goliath.stones_endurance.text: Self: you gain 1d12 + CON modifier temporary HP — When a blow is about to land, you shrug part of it off.

half_orc.relentless_endurance.name: Relentless endurance
half_orc.relentless_endurance.text: When you are downed, on yourself: revives a downed target with 1 HP (once per battle)

halfling.lucky.name: Lucky
halfling.lucky.text: When you miss, if it isn't a spell: weapon attack (weapon damage) (once per battle)

human.resourceful.name: Resourceful
human.resourceful.text: At the start of battle, on yourself: target gains 1 of its class resource, even above its maximum

monk.flurry_of_blows.name: Flurry of Blows
monk.flurry_of_blows.text: 1 tile: 2 times: weapon attack (1d8 + DEX modifier bludgeoning)

monk.martial_arts.name: Martial Arts
monk.martial_arts.text: Weapon attack, 1 tile: 1d8 + DEX modifier bludgeoning — A quick unarmed strike as a bonus action.

monk.step_of_the_wind.name: Step of the Wind
monk.step_of_the_wind.text: Self: you are Disengaged until the end of your turn; you gain your Move again — You Disengage and Dash in one bound.

monk.unarmed_strike.name: Unarmed Strike
monk.unarmed_strike.text: Weapon attack, weapon range: 1d8 + DEX modifier bludgeoning — Game balance: a 1d8 martial arts die at every level, with two attacks per Attack action. Ki and other features provide progression.

paladin.bless.name: Bless
paladin.bless.text: 4 tiles, burst 1: target gets +2 to attack rolls and +2 Str saves and +2 Dex saves and +2 Con saves and +2 Int saves and +2 Wis saves and +2 Cha saves for 10 rounds

paladin.command.name: Command
paladin.command.text: Wis save, 6 tiles: target is Incapacitated for 1 round — "Halt!" The target stands still and does nothing on its next turn.

paladin.compelled_duel.name: Compelled Duel
paladin.compelled_duel.text: Wis save, 4 tiles: taunts target for 10 rounds

paladin.divine_smite.name: Divine Smite
paladin.divine_smite.text: 1 tile: target is Marked for Smiting for 1 round — Your next melee hit on the target before the end of your next turn deals an extra 2d8 radiant (3d8 against undead and fiends).

paladin.lay_on_hands.name: Lay on Hands
paladin.lay_on_hands.text: 1 tile: heals 5 — Your healing pool holds 5 HP per paladin level each battle; each touch draws 5 of them.

paladin.shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
paladin.shield_of_faith.text: 6 tiles: target gets +2 AC for 10 rounds

paladin.smite_damage.name: Smite damage
paladin.smite_damage.text: When you hit, if you attack with a melee weapon and the target is Marked for Smiting: 2d8 radiant; if the target is undead or the target is fiend, 1d8 radiant; ends Marked for Smiting on target

ranger.ensnaring_strike.name: Ensnaring Strike
ranger.ensnaring_strike.text: Weapon attack, 8 tiles: weapon damage; Str save (target is Ensnared until saved) — On a hit, thorny vines bind the target: a STR save or restrained, taking 1d6 piercing each turn until it breaks free.

ranger.entangle.name: Entangle
ranger.entangle.text: 6 tiles, burst 1: creates a entangle zone (burst 1) for 10 rounds, difficult terrain, ends if you lose concentration; Str save (target is Restrained until saved)

ranger.hail_of_thorns.name: Hail of Thorns
ranger.hail_of_thorns.text: Weapon attack, 8 tiles: weapon damage; Dex save (1d4 piercing; half damage on a save); chains to up to 2 more targets within 1 tile — On a hit, your arrow bursts into thorns: up to two foes make a DEX save against thorns: 1d4 piercing, 1d6 from level 3.

ranger.hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
ranger.hunters_mark.text: 6 tiles: target is Hunted — Hits on a Hunted target deal an extra 1d4 force at levels 1 and 2, then 1d6 from level 3: a game balance progression.

ranger.hunters_mark_bonus.name: Hunters mark bonus
ranger.hunters_mark_bonus.text: When you hit, if the target is Hunted: 1d4 force

rogue.cunning_dash.name: Cunning Action: Dash
rogue.cunning_dash.text: Self: you gain your Move again

rogue.cunning_hide.name: Cunning Action: Hide
rogue.cunning_hide.text: Self: you are Hiding for 1 round. Only when you aren't in plain view — Plain view: a foe next to you, or one that sees you with no cover between (walls, crates, height, smoke). While you're hiding, attacks against you have disadvantage and your next attack has advantage (this is Steady Aim too). It ends when you attack or end your turn in plain view.

rogue.sneak_attack.name: Sneak attack
rogue.sneak_attack.text: When you hit, if you attack with a finesse or ranged weapon and (you have advantage or (an ally is next to the target and you don't have disadvantage)): 2d6 damage (once per turn)

rogue.vex.name: Vex
rogue.vex.text: When you hit, if you attack with a dart or rapier or shortbow or shortsword weapon: marks target as Vexed for 1 round (your attacks on it have advantage)

sorcerer.burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
sorcerer.burning_hands.text: Dex save, self, cone 3: 3d6 fire; half damage on a save

sorcerer.innate_sorcery.name: Innate Sorcery
sorcerer.innate_sorcery.text: Self: you get +1 spell DC and have advantage on your attack rolls for 3 rounds — Your innate magic surges for 3 rounds: +1 spell save DC and advantage on attack rolls.

sorcerer.metamagic_careful.name: Metamagic: Careful Spell

str.name: Strength
drives: Its modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 8 is −1, 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 20 is +5.

Attack and damage rolls with battleaxe, club, flail, glaive, greataxe, greatclub, greatsword, halberd, handaxe, javelin, lance, light hammer, longsword, longsword plus one, mace, maul, morningstar, pike, quarterstaff, quarterstaff plus one, sickle, spear, trident, war pick and warhammer.
Finesse weapons (dagger, dart, rapier, scimitar, shortsword and whip) use whichever of STR and DEX is higher.
STR saving throws, against effects that call for one; proficient for a Barbarian, Fighter, Monk or Ranger.
Skill checks in the story: Athletics.

dex.name: Dexterity
drives: Its modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 8 is −1, 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 20 is +5.
Attack and damage rolls with hand crossbow, heavy crossbow, light crossbow, longbow, shortbow, shortbow plus one and sling.
Finesse weapons (dagger, dart, rapier, scimitar, shortsword and whip) use whichever of STR and DEX is higher.
Armour Class: all of the modifier in light armour or none, at most +2 in medium, none in heavy.
Initiative: 10 + the modifier decides who acts first (heavy armour takes 2).
DEX saving throws, against effects that call for one; proficient for a Bard, Monk, Ranger or Rogue.
Skill checks in the story: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand and Stealth.

con.name: Constitution
drives: Its modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 8 is −1, 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 20 is +5.
Hit points: the modifier is added at level 1 and again at every level.
Armour Class without armour, for a Barbarian.
The save DC of Breath Weapon (Dragonborn).
CON saving throws, against effects that call for one; proficient for a Barbarian, Fighter or Sorcerer.
No skills use it.

int.name: Intelligence
drives: Its modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 8 is −1, 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 20 is +5.
Spell attacks and spell save DCs for a Wizard.
INT saving throws, against effects that call for one; proficient for a Druid, Rogue or Wizard.
Skill checks in the story: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature and Religion.

wis.name: Wisdom
drives: Its modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 8 is −1, 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 20 is +5.
Armour Class without armour, for a Monk.
Spell attacks and spell save DCs for a Cleric, Druid, Monk or Ranger.
WIS saving throws, against effects that call for one; proficient for a Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Warlock or Wizard.
Skill checks in the story: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception and Survival.

cha.name: Charisma
drives: Its modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 8 is −1, 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 20 is +5.

The save DC of Hellish Rebuke (Tiefling).
CHA saving throws, against effects that call for one; proficient for a Bard, Cleric, Paladin, Sorcerer or Warlock.
Skill checks in the story: Deception, Intimidation, Performance and Persuasion.
